claims.statement: Entered as no. 19 in the reconstructed catalogue of Leonardo's books, under Language, Rhetoric and Grammar. Leonardo's wording as rendered there: "the letters of Filelfo".
check_in: Leonardo's autograph book lists: Codex Trivulzianus f. 2r; Codex Atlanticus f. 559r; Madrid Codex II ff. 2v to 3r (which list names this title to be established)

claims.statement: Identified in the reconstruction as Epistolae (Franciscus Philelphus). The identification of a title in Leonardo's lists with a specific work and edition is an interpretation.
Composition and printing as given in the reconstruction: Composed mid 15th century · Printed 1473.
check_in: ISTC (Incunabula Short Title Catalogue) or Edit16 record for the edition
